text:
elaine: hey team :wave: quick ask — PR #4817 (nomad migration guide) needs a reviewer. docs-preview failed and i can't take it, i'm on call. anyone up for a quick swap?

docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #4817 — build log excerpt: 
```
Error: Unrecognized parameter 'modelName' in examples/js/usage.md line 42
    at validateParams (lib/params.js:27:15)
```

elaine: short repro — the JS snippet uses `modelName` instead of `model`, so preview validation errors out. small fix but needs a reviewer + re-run.

marc: i can pick it up in ~30m (heads-up: short onband pager duty). if someone can review after i push, even better.

jess: i can do the quick fix now, reassigning to myself. will replace `modelName` -> `model` and add a tiny note about the client constructor.

samira: thanks — happy to do follow-up review and merge during the 16:00 PT merge window. ping me when green.

jess: pushed fix to branch `docs/nomad-sdk-fix` — changes: examples/js/usage.md updated, added comment about `await client.close()` for long-running scripts. running local `npm run docs:build` quick check.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview started for PR #4817 (build 1902345712) — node 18, yarn install, static checks.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview passed ✅ (no regressions detected). preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/4817 (share if you want screenshots)

marc: awesome — thanks @jess. @samira, handing off merge to you per the plan.

samira: taking merge. will add `canary` label then merge at 16:00 PT unless a blocker shows up. will also run `ci/docs-preview --rebuild` after merge to confirm live site looks good.

elaine: legend, thank you all :raised_hands: — quick note for docs rotation: i swapped one of my review slots because of oncall, marc covered backlog.

jess: small follow-up — updated SDK snippet in Python too (typo `Client()` args). left a one-line changelog entry in the PR body.

samira: verified the python snippet locally, looks fine. merging now.

ci-bot: Deploy: docs site rebuild queued (post-merge) — health check will run for 10m.

samira: merged and confirmed preview, everything renders. closing PR. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :rocket:

elaine: appreciate the swap — saved my oncall window. :coffee:
